scripts.build: cd packages/contracts && npm run build && cd ../company && npm run build && cd ../cloud-client && npm run build && cd ../object-gateway && npm run build && cd ../runner-orchestrator && npm run build && cd ../runtime && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:runtime-bundle:release-train && npm run check:connector-catalog && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:cloud-boundaries && npm run check:wire-helpers && npm run check:migration-settings && tsgo --noEmit && tsgo -p packages/member-web/tsconfig.json && npm run build:web-sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace=@qorpera/web
scripts.build:web-sdk: npm run build --workspace=@qorpera/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@qorpera/company && npm run build --workspace=@qorpera/cloud-client
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
